$doNotEditByHand: Measured from the rendered scene. Re-run the script after any change to trackside geometry; do not hand-tune a number to make a test pass.
rule: limit = max(halfWidth, min(clampMax, tallGeometryLateral - hullMargin)); geometry at or below TALL_GEOMETRY_MIN_HEIGHT_METRES (0.6 m, the measured hull-bottom clearance) above the local deck plane does not bound, and neither does a collidable hazard.
